calculatorPage.title: Move-to-Greece calculator
calculatorPage.intro: See what you'd have left each month if you moved to Greece: first whether you're likely to qualify for the Article 5C break, then your net pay, rent and a comparison with the country you live in now.
calculatorPage.noscript: The quiz needs JavaScript to work.
quiz.skippedNotice: Some questions were skipped because their rules aren't verified yet.
quiz.q.priorResidence: In how many of the last {lookbackYears} years were you a tax resident of Greece?
quiz.q.priorResidence.hint: Count the years before you move your tax residence to Greece.
quiz.q.origin: Which country would you move your tax residence from?
quiz.q.work: How will you earn income in Greece?
quiz.work.greek_branch: Employee of a foreign company's Greek branch or permanent establishment
quiz.work.self_employed: Self-employed or own business in Greece
quiz.work.remote_foreign: Remote employee of a foreign company with no Greek presence
quiz.q.stay: Will you stay in Greece for at least {minimumStayYears} years?
quiz.results.title: Your result
quiz.outcome.likely_eligible.body: Based on your answers, you meet the main published conditions. This is not an approval.
quiz.outcome.borderline.body: At least one rule can't be judged with confidence. See which one below, and talk to a tax adviser.
quiz.outcome.likely_not_eligible.body: Based on your answers, at least one rule is not met.
quiz.ruleCards.title: Rule by rule
quiz.rule.label: Rule
quiz.answer.label: Your answer
quiz.source.label: Source
quiz.reason.invalid_config: This rule can't be applied right now.
quiz.rule.priorResidence: You must not have been a Greek tax resident for at least {requiredNonResidentYears} of the {lookbackYears} years before the move.
quiz.rule.priorResidence.generic: You must not have been a Greek tax resident for most of the years before the move. The exact number of years is not verified yet.
quiz.rule.origin: You must move your tax residence from an EU or EEA country, or from a country that has an administrative-cooperation agreement on tax matters in force with Greece.
quiz.rule.work: The break covers income from work in Greece: employment with a Greek employer or a Greek permanent establishment of a foreign company, or business activity in Greece.
quiz.rule.stay: You must declare that you'll stay in Greece for at least {minimumStayYears} years.
quiz.rule.stay.generic: You must declare that you'll stay in Greece for a minimum period. Its length is not verified yet.
quiz.note.remote: This is the most common grey area. Get confirmation from a Greek tax adviser before relying on the 50% break.
quiz.note.notWorking: Article 5C covers income from work. Other regimes exist for pensioners and investors; they're not covered by this tool.
quiz.note.otherCountry: Check whether Greece has an administrative-cooperation agreement on tax matters in force with this country.
quiz.note.cooperationUnconfirmed: We haven't yet confirmed that this country meets the cooperation condition.
quiz.disclaimer: This checks the main published conditions. It is not a ruling. Only AADE decides eligibility.
footer.disclaimer: Estimates only, not tax or financial advice.
